content:
Looking for new iPhone and iPad games to play? There are plenty of ad-free, no in-app purchase games on the App Store.

Apple Arcade is a family-friendly subscription option, but it's not the only one. If you're already a Netflix subscriber, you actually have access to a whole bunch of great iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription already includes a massive library of iPhone and iPad games

Now, every Netflix subscription plan includes a huge collection of mobile and TV games.

This includes the cheapest "Standard with ads" plan at $8.99 per month.

No matter which Netflix plan you're on, you can enjoy mobile and TV games with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra fees.

As for TV games, Netflix offers an app designed for iPhone and iPad called Netflix Game Controller.

This app turns your phone or tablet into an input device to use with a compatible Netflix smart TV app. If you want to further enhance your mobile gaming experience, a proper dedicated iPhone controller is the best choice.

Netflix also has an iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Playground, which offers mini-games for kids. There are also Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond these titles, Netflix has over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store and then log in with your Netflix email and password to play.
